group: The studio app — modules not yet brought over

modules.name: Dashboard (the home page)
modules.what: The rail's first item and 1.0's front door. By default a chat-first home: a greeting, the mAIson chat box with rotating capability chips, and widgets — Priority (overdue tasks, follow-ups due, unassigned new leads), Leads, Tasks, Projects, Chats, industry News from RSS feeds, Studio Pulse and Team Workload (Owners and Admins), and an Upcoming calendar. A Classic mode (Settings › Home Screen) shows KPI tiles, margin alerts, One-Click Profit, compliance alerts, a priority feed, project status, revenue trend and top clients — most of its figures are hard-coded samples.
modules.where_in_1: /dashboard — rail › Dashboard, the logo, phone dock › Home
modules.v1_code: src/app/(main)/dashboard/page.tsx; src/components/dashboard/* (chat-first-home, home-widgets, inline-response, recent-updates-feed, sparkline, donut-chart); src/app/api/news; src/app/api/buddy
modules.in_2: Rail › Dashboard and the phone dock's Dashboard say coming soon; 2.0 opens on Leads. Many of the numbers exist elsewhere: Company › Reports, the Tasks badge, Projects' Needs attention.

Settings › Home Screen: chat-first or classic

modules.name: mAIson assistant (AI chat)
modules.what: A chat panel behind the mAIson button on every page, and the home's chat box, backed by a real LLM (Gemini 2.5 Flash through OpenRouter) with 67 tools. It answers free questions about leads, projects, tasks and the books (P&L, GST, AR and AP ageing, cash flow, margins), draws charts, reads attached files and takes voice input. It can also write: create or update leads, tasks, projects, invoices, expenses, purchase orders and variation orders, record payments, change members' roles, draft client messages, and run a render or a floor-plan-to-3D.
modules.where_in_1: mAIson button on every page; the Dashboard's chat box; Settings › ID Buddy AI (a switch nothing reads)
modules.v1_code: src/components/layout/id-buddy-panel.tsx, buddy-chart-renderer.tsx, maison-fab.tsx; src/lib/agents/* (tools, executors, loop, system-prompt); src/lib/hooks/use-maison-stream.ts; src/app/api/buddy/chat
modules.in_2: Maison AI button and sheet on every page: one Ask box that answers by rule from the records (the schedule, a milestone, compliance, money for Owners and Admins, starting a project — "Answers from your records"), plus each page's suggestions, some of which act (Projects, Lead Overview). No model, no credits (REG-1644).
pending: Free questions on any topic — today the Ask box understands five
Leads, tasks, quotes and team questions ("which leads need attention", "my overdue tasks")
Money questions answered as reports: P&L, GST, AR and AP ageing, cash-flow forecast, commission
Charts drawn inside the answer
Changes by chat: create or update leads, tasks, projects, invoices, expenses, POs, VOs; record payments
Drafts: a WhatsApp follow-up or a client message for a picked lead
Attach a file: read a quote, find a room's surfaces, render a room, floor plan to 3D
Voice input
A conversation that carries from the home's chat box into the panel
modules.depends_on: an LLM with tool calls; AI credits pricing; her design for answers that change records
modules.why: The rule-based Ask box is the right stand-in; widening it to the lead, task and quote questions studios ask most needs no model. The real model, and what it may change without asking, is the developers' lane plus her call.
questions: May the assistant change records itself, or only propose a change the member confirms?
Should a question cost AI credits?

modules.name: Meeting Co-Pilot
modules.what: A meeting assistant. Before: pick a lead or project, set the aim, take consent, read a prep card. During (in person or a video call): a live transcript (Deepgram), AI nudges, a smart checklist, a deal score, an estimate built from what is said, renders and mood boards on request, portfolio search, a competitor's quote read on the spot, floor-plan notes. After: an AI brief (client profile, estimate, upsells, action items) saved to the lead, a draft quote, a public share link; History, Gallery, and for Owners and Admins Analytics with coaching and an Objections report. A recording can also be uploaded for a brief.
modules.where_in_1: Tools › Meeting Copilot (/tools/copilot-analytics); lead drawer › Start meeting; project › Meeting Summary card; /copilot/share/[shareId]
modules.v1_code: src/components/copilot/* (38 files); src/lib/copilot/*; src/app/api/copilot/* (34 routes); src/app/(main)/tools/copilot-analytics; src/app/copilot/share; src/components/projects/meeting-summary-card.tsx
modules.in_2: Tools › Meeting Copilot tile says Soon; the lead's Meetings tab and Meeting quick link are hidden (REG-552). The Met stage's meeting logs exist.

modules.name: Marketplace (brands and deals)
modules.what: A directory of Qanvast's partner brands (furniture, materials, services) and their deals. Brands by category with search, filters and sort, or a Deals view; a brand page with a gallery, services, web links, socials, FAQs, its deals and WhatsApp to the brand; a deal opens its terms, how to redeem and Get Deal. The data comes from Qanvast's brand API through /api/qanvast/* — those routes are not in the 1.0 repo, so this copy loads nothing.
modules.in_2: Rail › Marketplace and the phone's More › Marketplace say coming soon.
pending: Brands directory: categories, search, filters, sort, load more

modules.name: Chats: team and group conversations
modules.what: The Chats inbox: conversations between the studio's members, one-to-one or in named groups, optionally tied to a lead or a project, with outside phone numbers kept as participants (nothing is actually sent to them). Pinned chats, unread counts, attachments, emoji, a side panel with the linked project, and keyword-based reply suggestions (labelled AI, but a fixed list).
modules.in_2: Messages (/chat, rail › Messages): one conversation per project between the team and the client's household, also on the portal; read marks and photos.
pending: One-to-one chats between members

modules.why: 2.0 already has the conversation that matters to the client. Team chat competes with the WhatsApp groups studios already use, so ask before building it.
questions: Do studios need team chat inside OpenMaison, or is WhatsApp enough?

modules.name: Floor-plan photo to a 3D picture
modules.what: Upload a floor-plan photo taken at any angle; it is straightened and cleaned in the browser, an AI lists the rooms (which can be edited), the member picks Dollhouse (an angled cutaway) or Top-down, and an image model draws a furnished 3D picture to download. Marked Beta; it charges no AI credits.
modules.in_2: Tools › Floorplan to 3D Isometric opens the 3-D Space Planner in its isometric view (REG-1656, TD-098): a layout that is drawn or traced, not a picture made from an upload.
pending: Upload a floor-plan photo and get a furnished 3D picture
The room list read from the plan, editable before drawing
Two looks, Dollhouse and Top-down, and a download
modules.depends_on: an image model; an AI credits price
modules.why: The planner's isometric view already shows a plan in 3D with rooms you can change. The AI picture is a quicker wow for a first meeting, but it needs a real model.
questions: Is the planner's isometric view enough, or should a photo also make an AI picture, priced in credits?
